title: Bills vs. Rams: Listen Live to Monday Night Football on SiriusXM
summary: Catch every snap live on SiriusXM on car radios and the SiriusXM app.
body_markdown:
Listen live as the[Buffalo Bills](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/buffalo-bills) and[Los Angeles Rams](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/los-angeles-rams) face off on[Monday Night Football](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/monday-night-football-schedule-listen) during Week 5 of the 2026 NFL regular season live on SiriusXM on car radios and the SiriusXM app.


[Bills vs. Rams Today • 8:15PM ET Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk5-BillsRams)


Are you ready for some Monday Night Football? Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills are heading to sunny California to face-off against Matthew Stafford and the Los Angeles Rams for the final primetime mashup of week 5.


The Bills lead the AFC East, while the Rams are ranked third in the NFC West. And both teams are looking to secure a win.


### **How to Listen to Falcons vs. Saints**


**Date:** Monday, October 12
**Time:** 8:15pm ET
**Location:** SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, Calif.
**Bills broadcast:** Ch. 193 (car), Ch. 803 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk5-BillsRams) )
**Rams broadcast:** Ch. 192 (car), Ch. 818 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk5-BillsRams) )
**National broadcast:**[SiriusXM NFL Radio (Ch. 88)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-nfl-radio) (car and[app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk5-BillsRams) )
**Spanish-language broadcast:** Ch. 194 (car), Ch. 832 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk5-BillsRams) )


### **Every NFL Game Airs Live on SiriusXM**


Every NFL game, from the regular season through the Super Bowl, is available to SiriusXM listeners both in their vehicles and via the SiriusXM app. Through the app, subscribers can tune in to both home and visiting team broadcasts for every matchup.


Additionally, subscribers with sports play-by-play can access both home and road team broadcasts directly on their in-vehicle radios.


Visit[SiriusXM’s NFL schedule](https://www.siriusxm.com/sports/nfl) to see upcoming games and find the latest channel information.
